Overview

Indianapolis is a city in IN with a population of 882,039. Racing capital with a low cost of living, growing tech sector, and friendly Midwest vibe. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively high. The population skews young, with a median age of 34.1.
